apply_only: /acceptance_matrix (replace the unique element with id I1)
base.unchanged: Read all other criteria directly from the pinned immutable v2 blob. Preserve its literal/candidate and generation/reopening ACCEPT and the existing release gate order. The v2 artifact is retained without edits.

v2_reviewer.canonical_format: UTF-8 compact JSON, sorted keys, ensure_ascii=true.

roles.prior_exposure: Retain v2 shared owner and prior review disclosure.

provenance: Inherits exact v2 factual scope, seven exclusions, one NOAA educational source family, uncertainty and version-specific history. The erratum changes only intake criteria.

intake.precedence: Validate the optional public Boolean field at the public API boundary; invalid values reject without an intake effect. Offline preview and blocked exact literals never enter intake even if an optional Boolean true is supplied. A released/mapped literal also stays out of missing-coverage intake. Only an otherwise eligible unmapped request may proceed to consent and generation admission.
intake.sole_consent: The current eligible unmapped request's explicitly supplied JSON Boolean public_review:true is the only consent signal. Absent and Boolean false confer no consent. Other types are invalid. Do not coerce or infer consent from a request key, a previous request, or a saved result.
intake.idempotency: For an eligible unmapped request, compare any existing scoped request-key binding before admitting a new effect. Bind the original validated payload, the presence and value of the optional Boolean, and the admitted serving epoch to the scoped identity. At the current epoch, identical concurrent consented requests resolve to one stable job. An already-bound key with different payload or consent yields conflict with no new effect. An expired generation returns stale with no old result or job disclosure. No intake-side key binding is created by absent/false/invalid consent, preview or blocked literals.
intake.generation_fence: Check that the authorized serving epoch still matches inside the same authoritative transaction that guards the unique scoped key and writes the enqueue effect. If the epoch has changed or cannot be checked atomically with the write, perform no enqueue. Compare the expected epoch again during response disclosure as required by v2. Do not claim an enqueue to an external sink is transactional when it is not.
intake.staging: Use disposable inputs and an isolated outbox sink for all positive consent and concurrent tests. No public request or live job is part of this erratum. Preserve the reviewed order of implementation, curation/routing, isolated runtime, release and deployed readback.
